Officer's narrative
Driver 1 was traveling notrhbound on a two-lane county road in Pearland, Texas, when the vehicle operated by Driver
2 crossed into the northbound lane and made frontal contact with Driver 1's vehicle. Both vehicles were moving at low
speed at the time of impact. Driver 1 reported neck strain and was transported for evaluation. The nature of the
impact and the forces involved appear consistent with the reported injury. Damage to both vehicles is largely
consistent with a frontal collision of this type. Responding officers photographed the scene and the vehicles, and the
photographs confirm several details of the crash. No independent witnesses were identified. Driver 1 was the
operator of the vehicle, and records show Driver 1 is listed as a named driver on the applicable policy. A Passenger
was also present in Driver 1's vehicle, but it could not be fully determined from statements or the scene where the
Passenger and Driver 1 were seated at the moment of impact. No prior damage to Driver 1's vehicle is known to the
reporting officer.
